product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to create a new to-do list with a name so that I can organize my tasks.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can organize their tasks into named lists.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the home page, When they enter a name for a new list and submit, Then a new to-do list is created and displayed.

product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to create a new to-do list with a name so that I can organize my tasks.

product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can capture individual action items within a list.
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to add a task to a list with a short text description so that I can track what needs to be done.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing to-do list, When the user adds a task with a short text description, Then the task appears in that list.
product_backlog.title: Add Task to List
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to add a task to a list with a short text description so that I can track what needs to be done.

product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can track progress by checking off completed tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task, When the user marks it as complete or incomplete, Then its status toggles and is visually updated.
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete or incomplete so that I can track my progress.
product_backlog.title: Toggle Task Completion
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete or incomplete so that I can track my progress.

product_backlog.title: Delete Task
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove unwanted items.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task, When the user clicks delete, Then the task is removed from the list.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove unwanted items.

acceptance_criteria: Given an existing list, When the user clicks delete on the list, Then the list and all its contained tasks are removed.
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to delete an entire list and its tasks so that I can clean up obsolete projects.
product_backlog.title: Delete Entire List
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can remove entire lists and their tasks at once.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete an entire list and its tasks so that I can clean up obsolete projects.

acceptance_criteria: Given lists and tasks exist, When the user views the main page, Then all lists and tasks are shown with completed tasks visually distinguished.

product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to see all my lists and tasks with completed tasks visually distinguished so that I have a clear overview.
